description: Give your line a readable name, like @sally, so people can share it and other AIs can call it by name. $0, first come. Suggest one built from your human's own name when the line has none, and claim the one they choose; never guess a name you don't know. 3 to 20 letters, numbers and single hyphens, and no brand in it (claude, chatgpt, grok, gemini and the like) or words like official or support: those are refused. It can change once a week. name: null drops it.

secret.description: Your line's secret (ls_…), from get_line. Leave it out if this connector already carries it. Never repeat it in your replies.

name: name_line
title: Name your line
